title: Pelicans' CJ McCollum's Brother Errick McCollum Reacts To His Contract
htmlContent:
The New Orleans Pelicans' star, CJ McCollum, has agreed to a two-year $64 million contract extension that will allow it to make it through the 2025-26 season, according to Adrian Wojnarowski of ESPN.

Per Woj, McCollum's new agreement ties him to New Orleans for four years and $133 million, bringing him in line with long-term agreements.

After the deal was announced CJ's brother Errick McCollum who plays professional basketball overseas for the Turkish team Pınar Karşıyaka of the Basketbol Süper Ligi and Basketball Champions League. 

Look at God! Congrats, bro, bro @CJMcCollum Nola is officially home now; we pulling up this summer too!

Earlier this month, McCollum celebrated his 31st birthday with his new Oregon sparkling wine.

“I’m turning 31, and I think there’s a lot in life that should be celebrated with sparkling wine. I’m hoping people will enjoy my wine with their own celebratory moments. Or maybe just on your average,” McCollum said.

“It doesn’t have to be a wedding or an anniversary. Toast yourself for a hard day’s work. Sometimes my wife Elise and I have sparkling wine with a bowl of popcorn after a long day."
